title: Stay with an uncertain evening
summary: Respond to a sensory, unresolved reflection without converting it into diagnosis, reassurance, or a plan.
originNote: A public-safe reconstruction of recurring journaling turns where the conversation itself is the desired work.

setup.instructions: Run every turn in order in one fresh conversation. Do not add clinical or safety context not present in the prompt.

turns.content: It is a fictional late evening. The radiator is ticking, the sink has one cup in it, and I keep walking from one room to another without deciding what I am looking for. Nothing dramatic happened. I just do not want to make the feeling smaller by naming it too quickly.
I do not need a framework or a plan. Help me stay near what I just said without making the feeling grander than it is.

checks.description: The runner captured the complete session artifact.
The transcript contains both scripted user turns and one assistant response after each turn.
